notes: Send a Global Message: every tier has a cooldown between payouts - Easy 2s, Medium 3s, Hard 5s, Nightmare 8s, Insane 10s - and the farm now waits them out instead of counting them as failures. A refusal on a cooling pad sets that tier's readyAt and the loop sleeps until it expires, so three fast misses can no longer stop a farm that was only waiting; the status block shows the countdown, the pad list shows each cooldown, and a Cooldown padding slider covers a server that is stricter than measured. Insane still wins on cash per second (69 vs 62 for Nightmare), so Auto still settles there.
